ci.retry_reason: First push attempt timed out downloading Ubuntu media packages before test execution; identical commit passed on retry.

limitations: Does not mark story status DONE or assert a merge.
TESTED cites exercised behavior; no inference from a test name alone.

criteria.text: Pinned tool/runtime versions and fixed fixtures.
criteria.note: Live runtime compared with research/environment.lock.json; mismatches reported in the receipt.

criteria.text: Command emits source/policy/grammar digests, exact arguments, stdout and machine-readable result.
criteria.note: Receipt records argv, input digests and environment; stdout kept as stdout.json.

criteria.text: Repeat yields identical structural verdicts.
Any unavailable dependency causes explicit SKIP/UNKNOWN, not synthetic PASS.
criteria.note: Missing ffmpeg marks dependent components SKIP and the run INCOMPLETE.

criteria.text: Schema expresses mandatory fields, exact fields, allowable approximation and unanswered/unknown distinctions.
Every required field maps to immutable source anchors.
Unspecified critical fields cannot silently be treated as disposable.
Contract identifies task, author, reviewer, version and authorization scope.
criteria.note: Contracts carry task, author, reviewer, version and authorization.

criteria.text: Use existing `tools/packspec_compiler` and `unified_gate.py`; do not create a second self-certifying admission engine.
criteria.note: preservation.py uses unified_gate._checked_ir.

criteria.text: Each mapped obligation references reviewed IR node IDs, source hash, omission permission and independent-review signature.
Deferred/unsupported semantics remain UNKNOWN.
Any mismatch REFUSEs use.
Each candidate emits preserved, approximated, omitted, unknown and residual-required fields.
Every omission references a governing obligation and review disposition.
Unauthorized omissions block activation.
Replaying against a changed PackSpec invalidates stale approvals.
Reuse the existing module rather than rewriting it.
Typed endpoints checked on `PATH`; shared endpoint types checked on `AND`.
criteria.note: Checked by the reused module's own suite.

criteria.text: Unique minimal candidate requirement and budget-driven UNKNOWN retained.
Source fact IDs retained through path derivation.
SAT only if every modeled obligation is satisfied.
UNSAT includes minimal available counterexample and violated clause.
criteria.note: A single altered anchored obligation returns a reproducible field counterexample and CHANGED_REQUIRED_DISTINCTION clause.

criteria.text: Missing data or exhausted search returns UNKNOWN.
criteria.note: interpreter.execute_plan returns UNKNOWN when no check is UNSAT and verification is incomplete.

criteria.text: Finite SAT never emits QualityRag ADMIT or can_generate=true by itself.
Executes at least one source-anchored reversible mapping on non-video data.
Produces a transform trace and versioned source hash.
Unknown role/negation/temporal cases refuse or preserve raw source.
Round-trip tested for required distinction equivalence; no invented labels.

stories.title: RCT candidate search with early stopping

criteria.text: Explicit candidate count, depth, wall-clock/CPU and memory limits.
criteria.note: Candidate-count and depth limits come from the reused typed grammar and are reported with CPU/memory/wall budgets.

criteria.text: Deterministic selection for fixed search inputs.
Inconclusive search reports budget and discarded candidates.
Baseline “stay in present regime” is always considered.
Compilation records input obligation fingerprints and compiler version.
criteria.note: Receipt records compiler_version and input fingerprints.

criteria.text: Repeated equivalent queries reuse artifacts without changing verdicts.
Invalidated input/policy triggers recompile.
Actual compiled artifact bytes, construction time, cache hits and runtime costs measured.
criteria.note: Receipts measure canonical compiled bytes, construction/cache lookup, cache hits and actual validation/lens/gate runtime; absent execution is explicitly marked.

criteria.text: Compare relevant query results across source and transformed graph for all finite test pairs.
Include negative witnesses and role/order reversals.
Failure emits reproducible counterexample.
Result is scoped to finite graph and never generalized as universal meaning conservation.
criteria.note: Result carries scope DECLARED_FINITE_GRAPH_ONLY.

criteria.text: Typed entities, roles, polarity, quantity/unit, temporal order, modality, provenance and unknowns are representable.
Invalid joins/roles rejected by type checker.
Source quote, byte/character anchors and hashes stored.
Canonical serialization round-trips.

stories.title: Exact information and reversible source custody

criteria.text: Raw-source immutable reference or lossless original bytes retained.
Every omission has a location and residual/refetch plan.
criteria.note: Each authorized omission carries its source anchor and a REFETCH_FROM_CUSTODY plan.

criteria.text: Content hash verification catches corruption.
Unavailable original causes an explicit fidelity limitation/REFUSE.
Two complete initial adapters (e.g., PDF and CSV), plus text fixture.
Text/tabular spans map back to original pages/rows.
Unsupported structure is marked UNKNOWN, not silently dropped.
criteria.note: PDF projection lists unsupported content and reports coverage UNKNOWN.

criteria.text: Unit/regression tests include duplicated headings and malformed input.
Reuse existing v1.2 explicit `RELATE` and v1.3 bounded linguistic extractors.
criteria.note: adapters.py calls the existing v1.2 and v1.3 extractors.

criteria.text: Opposite polarity candidates quarantined.
Caller endorsement remains unauthenticated until authorization added.
Tests include actor/beneficiary swaps and negation changes.

stories.title: Reusable grammar registry and dependency DAG

criteria.text: DAG is acyclic and dependencies are typed.
Resolution identifies missing/incompatible modules before use.
Signed release metadata covers transitive dependencies.
Authorized rollback to a signed, compatible, non-revoked release is tested; minimum-version policy remains enforced.
Typed interpreter implements bounded, sandboxed operators with no `eval`/dynamic imports.
criteria.note: Finite language sandbox: rejects code/import/callback/runtime options and sequences exceeding 32 steps. This is not an arbitrary-code process sandbox.

criteria.text: Uses actual transformed output, not merely stated `preserves` lists.

VERIFY compares actual output to all anchored obligations; fallback must independently satisfy authorization, compatibility, preservation and resource limits. At most one fallback attempt; failure terminates in REFUSE without releasing output.
Replay emits deterministic execution trace.
Manifest pins payload codec, grammar hash, model hash, runtime ABI and required modules.
criteria.note: Grammar is now pinned separately from the model, with an explicit required-module map.

criteria.text: Missing, incompatible or unsigned module refuses/fallbacks.
Old payloads are decoded only by verified-compatible decoders.
Incompatible upgrade cannot silently alter old content.
Structured/text source can be reconstructed byte-for-byte or with clearly specified canonical normalization.
Residual-only errors cause REFUSE.
Fixed inputs/versions produce identical outputs and hashes.
Tests cover missing, modified and out-of-order segments.
Ingest actual frames and output a versioned decodable payload.
Decoder manifest pins shared model and modules.
A complete decode demonstrably reconstructs playable clip.
Encoding time, bytes, model size and fallback ratio measured. **Not accomplished by PR #69**.
criteria.note: encode() reports encode_ns, payload_bytes, model_bytes and fallback_ratio.

criteria.text: Account for grammar construction, encoding, residuals, model installation, updates, bandwidth, storage, decoding electricity and verification.
Analyze cold/new viewer, frequent viewer, smart TV and mobile cases.
Break-even conditions plus uncertainty bounds presented.
If no crossover, report negative result.
Segment index supports seek, pause/resume and bitrate changes.
Scene state dependencies are explicit.
Missing module/segment falls back without silent frame corruption.
Measure startup latency, buffering and seek times against AV1 baseline.
criteria.note: Actual local bounded playback measures startup, queue-empty stalls and seeks for both signed reference segments and AV1. WAN and physical-device performance remain unmeasured.

criteria.text: Stores source turn ID/hash, actor and timestamp.
Branches can fork/rejoin without cycles.
Replay deterministically rebuilds tree after restart.
No inference-generated concept is treated as reviewer-approved.
All transitions are append-only events.
PRUNE deactivates rather than deletes.
SYNTHESIZE records dependencies but never inherits VALIDATED from parent.
REOPEN restores reference context and prior counterexamples.
criteria.note: REOPEN exposes reopened_context: what pruned the branch and every prior challenge.

stories.title: Evidence-state separation and Research Ledger link

criteria.text: Maps hypotheses to `tools/research_ledger` claims.
No VALIDATED promotion without independent verifier and evidence IDs.
Dependency uncertainty propagates as unresolved.
Tamper and hash-chain tests detect corruption within stated trust boundary.

stories.title: Gardener proposal loop and review UI

criteria.text: Bounded scheduled job operates only on authorized sources.
criteria.note: service.start_proposal_loop is bounded and tenant-scoped.

criteria.text: Produces candidate events with source anchors, confidence/calibration and suggested cost.
criteria.note: suggested_cost: events, branches affected, and median reviewer-reported time (None until history exists).

criteria.text: Structural edits are previewable and reversible, promotion requires review.
Reports false merges, branch churn, cost and utility; no autonomous truth claim.
Candidate agents run with scoped CPU/token/time and tool permissions.
Every proposal includes parent grammar hash, patches and rationale.
criteria.note: All six roles return an explicit patch list, parent grammar hash and rationale; non-editing proposals use an empty list.

criteria.text: Restricted execution sandbox prevents arbitrary host changes.
Evaluation always runs on pinned code/datasets.
criteria.note: Worker recomputes code/schema/runtime and exact finite task-dataset pins before sandbox execution; parent verifies returned pin. This is not external corpus validation.

criteria.text: Each has a distinct versioned contract/schema.
Roles produce inspectable artifacts, not opaque prose.
Guardian can block but cannot invent verification evidence.
criteria.note: Guardian decision REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW blocks; it never produces verification evidence.

criteria.text: Integration tests show disagreement and escalation, not forced consensus.
Family-disjoint holdouts are hidden from proposing agents.
Test actor/recipient reversal, negation, time, units, captions, residual tamper and incompatible model.
Any critical regression blocks promotion.
False-accept rate and missed-counterexample rate tracked.
criteria.note: adversaries.challenge reports false-accept and missed-counterexample rates.

criteria.text: Rank by expected information/decision value against investigation cost.
Pareto frontier covers bytes, latency, energy, fidelity and total cost; reject dominated options unless justified.
Budget exhaustion stops runs predictably.
Promotion requires independent reviewer approval and signed immutable release.
Authenticated principal and tenant-scoped authorization per source and artifact.
Cross-tenant reads, guessed IDs and leaked residuals denied in tests.
Reviewer and custodian identities cryptographically bound.
Logs do not disclose source content outside authorized scope.
Key rotation and version policy documented.
criteria.note: Verified signed-bundle minimum sequence/revocation documentation and completion-receipt rotation/compromise policy; runtime rollback behavior has separate tests.

criteria.text: Signatures bind source, grammar, policy, model, decoder and relevant run IDs.
Unauthorized replay/downgrade attacks produce refusal; explicit authorized rollback must respect compatibility, revocation and minimum-version policy.
Existing signed-bundle code reused, not silently substituted with raw hashes.
criteria.note: authority.py reuses tools/packspec_compiler/signed_bundles.py.

criteria.text: JSON/typed interfaces support validation, evaluate, trace and fallback.
Golden fixtures produce identical finite verdicts across languages.
Unsupported API options explicitly fail.
Examples demonstrate external PackSpec and source-backed receipts.
